items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps dry, sensitive-feeling skin comfortable and doesn't add to the look of redness.
A soothing gel with centella that helps skin feel calmer and look less flushed after heat.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the skin barrier and add comfort to skin that scanned low on moisture.
A mineral SPF 50 is usually gentler on easily flushed skin, and sun and heat can make the look of redness worse.

response.routine_note: Mornings: cleanse, apply the soothing gel, then moisturizer and sunscreen; evenings: cleanse, soothing gel, moisturizer, and skip exfoliating acids and retinoids for now. Since the flushing comes and goes with heat and wine, it is worth showing a dermatologist if it keeps happening, stings or burns, or gets worse, as that is beyond what skincare can address.
